claims.claim_text: The paper presents Dr. RTL, a multi-agent framework that automates critical-path analysis, RTL rewriting, and implementation-level evaluation, and continuously improves through reusable optimization skills.
claims.excerpt: We present Dr. RTL, a multi-agent framework that automates critical-path analysis, RTL rewriting, and implementation-level evaluation, while continuously improving through reusable optimization skills.

claims.claim_text: The authors report that Dr. RTL, evaluated on 20 real-world RTL designs, achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21%/17% with a 6% area reduction over commercial synthesis.
claims.excerpt: Evaluated on 20 real-world RTL designs, Dr.~RTL achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21\%/17\% with a 6\% area reduction over commercial synthesis.

claims.claim_text: The paper is an ASP-DAC'27 invited paper, submitted to arXiv on 10 November 2026.
The paper is authored by Wenji Fang, Yao Lu, Jinghua Wang and Zhiyao Xie.
claims.excerpt: Authors:Wenji Fang, Yao Lu, Jinghua Wang, Zhiyao Xie
